ladder.note: 164 nights, one bet each, priced from the books' real X+ rung prices (ESPN BET closing lines, margin removed) and turned into the odds Winamax is expected to pay; players chosen from the injury report at the lock.
ladder.verdict: The bets landed 87 of 164 (53%) against 85.9 stated: honest chances, +12.9 units at 1 unit a night, best climb 7 levels. On nights with nothing at 2.00-2.10 it takes the best-value bet near 2.0, never just the closest odds.
